best_idea: A carrier holds a fixed count per kind, takes only what the source actually gives each tick, and pays out in one drop-off call that moves exactly the accepted amounts into the owner's ledger.
decision_why: Take the per-kind cap, the one-call drop-off and the size-weighted slot check for multi-slot units, so one ledger and weight and capacity both have a rule. Change the switch rule: the donor drops the load silently (ResourceGatherer.js:192-193), which would break one ledger; Frankendom refuses the switch and keeps the load. Caps are catalogue fields, not zone data.
acceptance: A server test: a carrier with cap 10 takes at most 1 per tick and reports full at 10; switching to another kind is refused with the load unchanged; a drop-off moves the whole accepted load into the player's ledger in one call and leaves unaccepted kinds on the carrier; a 2-slot unit is refused by a holder with 1 slot free.
